Did you see this most recent sample?
3. Was it collected under required parameters (i.e. in coffin bottle, preservative)?
4. Is it reportable to Dept. of Health or aggregates? 45CFR S88, §75.30 (PDF, 41KB)
5. Is the test reportable?
6. Did you send it to a certified lab or accredited (Master Sampler Level 1) sampler and pay to have it tested?
7. Was the container sealed at the job site? OTC rule
8. Go back to the inspection records.
9. Was anything missing since the last inspection?
10. Did you meet all safety regulations when inspecting/UV testing any wells? Cal. Code Regs. tit. 24 (Building), Ch. 4 (Plumbing), Art. 4.5.6 (Backflow Prevention
